observables.fields: accepted_global_reads / accepted_oracle_candidates / accepted_ro / transactions / merges / detached / lower_sectors / responses / live
observables.interpretation: Distinguish accepted certified demand from transaction and merge. detached is success count; detach is enable flag. Zero success does not identify no pressure/no opportunity/reuse_seen/allready.

observables.fields: peak_transactions / peak_shared_descriptors / peak_shared_lines / normal_line_allocations / avoided_line_allocations / query_count / query_wait_cycles / query_port_wait_attempts
observables.interpretation: Per-slice high-water/cumulative query and native-line allocation evidence; peak_shared_lines alone cannot exclude transient set conflict.
Only four exported frontend-head nonexclusive first-to-accept wait classes; no complete landing/WAD/detach eligibility histogram. Do not sum into critical path.

observables.fields: native_descriptor_responses / ro_descriptor_responses / shared_descriptor_used / shared_line_used / ro_live / epoch_closed
observables.interpretation: Use alongside process exit0, complete commandlist and all existing required closure/drain records. No tail/progress substitute.

observables.fields: peak_lower_transactions / peak_independent_lower_lines / epoch begin/end / last_response / completed_ro_requesters
observables.interpretation: In-flight issued-notreturned pressure. Same-address detached instances can exceed independent-line count; no warp independence inference.

observables.fields: tag allocation need / allreserved sampled blockers
observables.interpretation: l2cache.cc1359-1369,2058 uses preview; eligible detach can turn reservation failure into MISS. Not full can_detach call/refusal counts or counterfactual original pressure.

missing_observables: No can_detach attempted/scanned/rejected-by-reason counters (reuse_seen vs ready vs notattached/nonRO).
No per-set pending-certified-live occupancy/time overlap with actual incoming tag pressure; no critical-path assignment from total waits.
No parent/sibling UID independence classification; merges count mem_fetch requesters, not necessarily independent warps.
